name: Camouflage
overview: To escape an arranged engagement and find someone who truly loves him, wealthy heir Adrian secretly assumes the identity of his kind-hearted blind twin, Eden. While his fiancée Michelle showers Adrian with affection but cruelly mistreats the "blind" brother, Adrian discovers her true nature and unexpectedly falls for Clara, the family's compassionate maid. As deception, jealousy, and hidden identities collide, Adrian must reveal the truth and choose between duty and the love he never expected.
